stories.title: Customer Registration Form (Happy Path)
stories.user_story: As a new customer, I want to register for the loyalty program with my name, email, and phone number, so that I can start earning points on my purchases
acceptance_criteria: Given I'm on the registration screen, When I enter valid name, email (RFC 5322), phone (E.164), and password (12+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, special), Then the Submit button becomes enabled
Given I submit valid registration data, When the account is created, Then I receive a success message and am redirected to the OTP verification screen
Given my email is already registered, When I attempt to register, Then I see 'An account with this email already exists — try logging in' without revealing whether the account is active
Given the registration form, When navigated via screen reader, Then each field is announced with its label, required status, and any validation error

domain_kb_sections: persona-cards — Clara (Cash/Debit Shopper), Nathan (Dunelmpay Account Holder)

stories.reasoning: 3 points: form + validation + API call + error handling. Duplicate check doesn't reveal account existence (security). Accessibility AC per Rule 22. Security: no PII in error messages.

stories.title: Registration Validation & Rate Limiting (Negative Path)
stories.user_story: As a security-conscious platform, I want registration attempts validated and rate-limited, so that bots and abuse are prevented
acceptance_criteria: Given an invalid email format, When I blur the email field, Then inline error shows 'Please enter a valid email address' immediately
Given a password with fewer than 12 characters, When I type, Then the strength meter shows 'Weak' in red and the requirement checklist shows unmet criteria
Given 5 registration attempts from the same IP in 1 hour, When the 6th attempt is made, Then it is blocked with 'Too many attempts — please try again later'
Given the registration API receives a request, When processing, Then PII (email, phone) is not written to application logs
stories.reasoning: 2 points: validation rules + rate limiter. Negative path story per Rule 21. Security AC: PII not logged per Rule 23.

stories.title: In-Store Assisted Registration
stories.user_story: As a store associate, I want to register a customer for the loyalty program at the POS, so that walk-in customers can join without needing the app
acceptance_criteria: Given I'm authenticated as a store associate, When I access the registration API with staff token, Then I can create a customer account on their behalf
Given I enter the customer's details, When registration completes, Then the customer receives a verification email/SMS to activate their account
Given the staff registration endpoint, When called without a valid staff role token, Then it returns 403 Forbidden

requirements_used: FR-04 — Multi-Channel Loyalty Sign-Up (mobile app, website, or in-store)

stories.reasoning: 2 points: staff-facing API endpoint + authorization check. Supports the in-store channel per FR-04. Store associate persona (Sana) needs this capability.

stories.title: OTP Verification
stories.user_story: As a new customer, I want to verify my email via a one-time code, so that my account is activated and secured
acceptance_criteria: Given I've registered, When I check my email, Then I receive a 6-digit OTP within 30 seconds
Given I enter the correct OTP within 5 minutes, When I submit, Then my account status changes to 'active' and I'm redirected to the login screen
Given the OTP has expired (> 5 minutes), When I enter it, Then I see 'Code expired — request a new one' with a resend button
Given I've requested 3 OTPs in 10 minutes, When I request a 4th, Then I see 'Too many attempts — try again in 10 minutes'
stories.reasoning: 3 points: OTP generation + email delivery + verification logic + rate limiting. 5-minute expiry balances security with usability.

stories.title: OTP Failure Handling
stories.user_story: As a new customer, I want clear feedback when my OTP verification fails, so that I know what went wrong and how to fix it
acceptance_criteria: Given I enter an incorrect OTP, When I submit, Then I see 'Invalid code — {remaining} attempts remaining' and the input field is cleared
Given I've failed OTP verification 5 times, When the 5th failure occurs, Then my verification is blocked for 30 minutes and I'm notified via email
Given the resend countdown is active (60 seconds), When I look at the resend button, Then it shows a countdown timer and is disabled until it reaches zero
stories.reasoning: 2 points: error states + lockout logic. Negative path story per Rule 21. Lockout notification prevents confusion.

stories.title: Email/Password Login
stories.user_story: As a returning customer, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can access my loyalty account securely
acceptance_criteria: Given I enter valid credentials, When I submit, Then I receive a JWT access token (15-min expiry) and refresh token (30-day on mobile, 7-day on web) and am redirected to the dashboard
Given I enter incorrect credentials, When I submit, Then I see 'Invalid email or password' (not specifying which is wrong) and the attempt is logged
Given 5 consecutive failed login attempts, When the 5th fails, Then the account is locked for 30 minutes and I see 'Account locked — try again at {time}'
Given my session token expires, When I make an API call, Then the refresh token is used to obtain a new access token transparently
stories.reasoning: 3 points: login form + JWT issuance + refresh flow + lockout. Restricted because handles credentials. Generic error message prevents account enumeration.

stories.title: Social Login (Google & Apple)
stories.user_story: As a new or returning customer, I want to log in with my Google or Apple account, so that I can access the loyalty program without creating another password
acceptance_criteria: Given I'm on the login screen, When I tap 'Continue with Google', Then the Google OAuth consent screen appears and upon approval, I'm logged in with my account linked
Given I'm on the login screen, When I tap 'Sign in with Apple', Then the Apple Sign In flow appears with option to hide email, and upon approval, I'm logged in
Given I've previously registered with email/password, When I log in via social with the same email, Then the accounts are linked and both login methods work

requirements_used: FR-16 — User Authentication (social login Google, Apple)

stories.reasoning: 3 points: two OAuth provider integrations + account linking logic. Restricted because handles auth tokens. Account linking prevents duplicate accounts.

stories.title: Password Reset Flow
stories.user_story: As a customer who forgot my password, I want to reset it via email, so that I can regain access to my loyalty account
acceptance_criteria: Given I tap 'Forgot password', When I enter my registered email, Then I receive a reset link within 30 seconds (valid for 1 hour)
Given I click the reset link, When I set a new password meeting strength requirements, Then my password is updated and all existing sessions are invalidated
Given I enter an unregistered email, When I submit, Then I see the same success message ('If an account exists, you'll receive a reset link') to prevent enumeration
Given the reset link has expired (> 1 hour), When I click it, Then I see 'This link has expired — request a new one'

requirements_used: FR-16 — User Authentication (password reset via email link)

stories.reasoning: 3 points: reset request + email delivery + token validation + password update + session invalidation. Same-message-regardless prevents account enumeration.

stories.title: Terms & Conditions Acceptance During Registration
stories.user_story: As a new customer, I want to review and accept the loyalty program terms before completing registration, so that I understand the program rules and my data rights
acceptance_criteria: Given I'm on the registration form, When I view the T&C section, Then I see a scrollable T&C text with an unchecked 'I accept the Terms & Conditions' checkbox
Given the T&C checkbox is unchecked, When I try to submit, Then the form shows 'You must accept the Terms & Conditions to continue'
Given I check the box and submit, When registration completes, Then the system records: customer_id, t&c_version (e.g., 'v1.2'), acceptance_timestamp, and IP address
Given the T&C link, When tapped, Then the full terms open in a modal/new screen that is scrollable and accessible via screen reader
stories.reasoning: 2 points: checkbox + validation + consent recording. Unchecked by default per GDPR (no pre-ticked boxes). Regulatory linkage: GDPR Art. 7 consent conditions.

stories.title: T&C Re-Acceptance on Version Update
stories.user_story: As a returning customer, I want to be prompted to accept updated terms when they change, so that I'm always informed of current program rules
acceptance_criteria: Given the T&C version has been updated since my last acceptance, When I log in, Then a modal displays the updated T&C requiring re-acceptance before I can proceed
Given the re-acceptance modal is shown, When I decline, Then I'm logged out with a message: 'You must accept the updated terms to continue using the loyalty program'
Given I accept the updated T&C, When recorded, Then the new version and timestamp replace my previous consent record in the audit trail
stories.regulatory_linkage: UK GDPR Article 7 (re-consent on material changes)

requirements_used: FR-27 — Terms & Conditions Acceptance (re-accept on update)

stories.reasoning: 2 points: version check on login + modal + consent update. Blocking modal ensures no one uses the program under outdated terms.
